title: Volve (real data): 4D on the Hugin Fm top

control_label: Utsira top, about 900 ms, above any production effect
bulk_note: bulk shift +2.44 ms: the median lag of the monitor against the base on the control horizon over 220095 picks (p10 +1.0, p90 +3.8 ms); removed before anything else was measured, because a constant offset between two processings (first-sample convention, statics, datum, velocity model) is not a change in the earth

reference.label: interpreters' fault polygons, Hugin Fm top (2014)

notes: amplitudes are relative; compare within this file only

classes: k-means on the shape-normalised base windows, the monitor assigned to the nearest base class after its time shift is removed (a class change is a change of shape); the number of classes is a judgement
shift: cross-correlation lag of the monitor against the base, refined between samples, after the declared bulk shift; positive = later in the monitor; NRMS is measured before the shift is removed
at the repeatability of two surveys some change is noise: read every reservoir number against the control horizon

Volve ST10010 PSDM full stack (3-41 degrees), depth-to-time converted, 4 ms; domain TIME and quantity AMPLITUDE as stated by the user from the text header; polarity unknown (not stated in the headers)
time-vs-depth check (seismic_lib): leans time; the cube is blank above about 196 ms (shallow mute), so its own seabed cannot be used
water bottom from the interpreters' horizons: 111 ms TWT and 91 m depth over the survey; read as time it implies 82 m of water, read as depth 111 m: only time fits

base: ST0202, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T (ST0202ZDC12-PZ-PSDM-KIRCH-FULL-T.MIG_FIN.POST_STACK.3D.JS-017534.segy); monitor: ST10010, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T; both PZ full-angle PSDM stacks converted to time, 4 ms, on the same grid; shot with different cable layouts and sources eight years apart, so repeatability is what the control horizon says it is

windows of +-40 ms matched-filter aligned on the base at the Hugin Fm top picks (picks further than 12 ms from their neighbours' median excluded); the monitor read at the same times after the bulk shift; shifts searched within +-12 ms

the published 4D interpretation of Volve (Hallam et al. 2020, First Break 38) attributes the signal mainly to water sweep, with at most about 5% impedance change: expect a subtle effect, not a bright one
source_label: base ST0202, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T; monitor ST10010, full stack, PSDM Kirchhoff, name ends _T
